henrietta_resident.text: Come in, bairn. Sit by the fire. The wind off the harbour finds every gap in this house.
Henrietta Street sits at the foot of the abbey steps, and the abbey above us was founded over 1,300 years ago.
If a jetling is eyeing your shiny things, give it something small and bright instead. It will forgive you, mostly.
Our Billy says mither when he means bother. He mithers me every day, bless him, and I would not swap him.
